data.title: 德尔塔 · 阳光树荫下的忠犬打盹
data.description: 午后微风轻拂的大树草坪下，德尔塔将脸枕在少年的膝头甜美入睡，毛茸茸的长尾巴轻轻环在两人身边，犬耳不时因梦境微微抖动。
data.location: lush grassy hill under giant shady oak tree on a gentle breezy afternoon
data.action: sleeping peacefully curled up with head resting on lap pillow, bushy tail wrapped around, dog ears twitching slightly
data.lighting: soft dappled leaf shadows and warm peaceful sunlight
data.mood: serene domestic tenderness, absolute trust, peaceful cuddly slumber
data.promptProse: Under a shady tree on grassy hill, black-haired wolf girl Delta sleeps curled up peacefully on a lap pillow.
data.animaCaption: Delta sleeping peacefully on a lap pillow under the summer tree.
